## Summary

Fixed the search bug in `PostController.search()` (app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts). The problem was that the `published` filter was incorrectly placed inside an OR group with the keyword searches, causing the query to return unpublished posts matching keywords and published posts that don't match any keyword.

**The fix:** Moved `.where('published', true)` outside the keyword OR group so it ANDs with the keyword filter. Now the search correctly returns only published posts that contain at least one search keyword in their title or excerpt, and unpublished posts never appear regardless of keyword matches. Both typecheck and test suite pass.
